steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place Salmon skin-side down on the sheet; drizzle with 10 ml Olive oil and season with Salt.
Bake Salmon 12 to 14 minutes, until it flakes easily with a fork.
Meanwhile, rinse Quinoa and cook in 400 ml Water in a medium saucepan, 12 to 15 minutes, until fluffy.
Finely dice Onion and mince Garlic; cook in remaining Olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, 3 minutes.
Add Cooked lentils to the skillet; stir and heat through for 2 minutes.
Add Spinach; cook 1 to 2 minutes, stirring, until wilted.
Stir in Lemon juice and Fresh dill; remove from heat.
Flake baked Salmon into large pieces and serve over Quinoa with the lentil and spinach mixture.
Yield: 4 family portions. Refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 2 days.
